modules.summary: Aim angles for a cue ball on a table plane (x along the table, z across; angles in radians, atan2 convention).

functions.name: aimAngle
functions.description: Aim from the cue ball toward the pointer (dragging on the felt).

params.name: cue
params.description: Cue ball centre.

params.name: point
params.description: Pointer position on the table plane.

params.name: previous
params.description: Angle to keep when the pointer sits on the cue ball.

returns.description: Angle in radians from the cue ball to the pointer.

edge: A pointer within 1e-6 of the cue ball returns previous unchanged.

functions.name: dragAngle
functions.description: Aim while dragging the cue butt itself: the butt follows the pointer, so the shot goes the opposite way.

params.name: cue
params.description: Cue ball centre.

params.name: point
params.description: Pointer position (the cue butt).

params.name: previous
params.description: Angle to keep when the pointer sits on the cue ball.

returns.description: Shot angle in radians, pointing from the pointer through the cue ball.

edge: A pointer within 1e-6 of the cue ball returns previous unchanged.

modules.summary: Hit test for grabbing a cue shaft that lies behind the cue ball (x along the table, z across; metres).

functions.name: hitsCue
functions.description: True when a point lies on the visible cue shaft behind the cue ball.

params.name: cue
params.description: Cue ball centre.

params.name: angle
params.description: Shot angle in radians; the shaft extends opposite to it.

params.name: point
params.description: Point to test (pointer on the table plane).

params.name: radius
params.description: Cue ball radius; the shaft starts one radius behind the centre.

params.name: pullOffset
params.description: How far the cue is currently pulled back.

params.name: grab
params.description: Tolerance around the shaft.

returns.description: Whether the point can grab the cue.

edge: Points in front of the ball, beyond the shaft length, or farther than grab from its line return false.
functions.signature: hitsCue(cue, angle, point, radius, pullOffset = 0, grab = CUE.grabRadius)

constants.name: CUE
constants.description: Cue geometry in metres: shaft length 1.47 and the grab radius around the shaft (0.05).

modules.summary: Pull-to-shoot gesture math. Pure functions: no DOM, no globals.
modules.notes: Units: pointer positions and distance share one unit (pixels); ratios are 0..1.

functions.name: pullRatio
functions.description: How far a drag has travelled along a track, clamped to 0..1.

params.name: start
params.description: Pointer position where the drag began.

params.name: current
params.description: Current pointer position.

params.name: distance
params.description: Track length in the same unit as the positions.

edge: A track length of 0 or less returns 0.

functions.name: shotStrength
functions.description: Power curve: gentle pulls stay gentle, full pulls reach 1.

params.name: ratio
params.description: Pull ratio; values outside 0..1 are clamped.

functions.name: reachesMinPull
functions.description: True when a released pull is long enough to shoot. Tolerates 1e-6 of representation error: browsers report pointer coordinates as float32 (e.g. 332.04998779296875), so an intended exact 5% pull can compute to 0.04999997 and must still shoot.

params.name: ratio
params.description: Pull ratio at release.

params.name: min
params.description: Minimum ratio that still shoots.

returns.description: Whether the pull reaches the minimum.

edge: Exactly the minimum shoots; anything clearly below (for example 0.049) does not.

constants.name: PULL
constants.description: Gesture thresholds: minimum pull ratio to shoot (0.05) and the power-curve exponent (1.5).

modules.summary: Clamp a number into the range min..max.

functions.name: clamp
functions.description: Limit a number to the inclusive range min..max.

params.name: value
params.description: The input value.

params.name: min
params.description: Lower bound (inclusive).

params.name: max
params.description: Upper bound (inclusive); expected min <= max.

edge: NaN in gives NaN out; arguments are not validated.

modules.summary: First-contact aftermath estimate for equal-mass balls (plane coordinates: x, z).
modules.notes: Frictionless model: ignores spin, friction and any later collision, so it is a guide, not a simulation.

functions.name: postContact
functions.description: Directions the object ball and the cue ball leave in after the cue ball first touches a ball.

params.name: balls
params.type: Array<{id: number, x: number, z: number}>
params.description: Ball positions.

params.name: angle
params.description: Shot angle of the cue ball in radians.

params.name: contact
params.type: {kind: string, id?: number, x: number, z: number}
params.description: First contact; x, z is the cue ball centre at contact.

returns.description: { object: {x, z, scale}, cue: {x, z, scale} | null }: unit directions with a 0..1 scale (share of the shot's speed); null when there is no ball contact.

edge: A contact that is not a ball (cushion, pocket) returns null.
A head-on hit leaves the cue ball with no tangent: cue is null.
An unknown ball id, or a contact centred on the ball, returns null.
examples: postContact([{id: 0, x: 0, z: 0}, {id: 3, x: 1, z: 0}], 0, {kind: "ball", id: 3, x: 0.9429, z: 0}) // => {object: {x: 1, z: 0, scale: 1}, cue: null}
postContact([{id: 0, x: 0, z: 0}], 0, {kind: "cushion", x: 1, z: 0}) // => null
